theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_st_coord_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v g : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (δ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → (∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1) → 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ 1 / 4 → |∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ j, δ < z j ∧ z j < 1 - δ}, fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y * g y) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)| ≤ 4 * (∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ j, δ < z j ∧ z j < 1 - δ}, |v x|) + 2 * ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ j, δ < z j ∧ z j < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖
